settings.themeDesc: Pick a theme, applied live. Each theme comes from a separate theme plugin.
settings.fontDesc: Fonts use the system stack, zero bundling. Theme / font size / font prefs persist across restarts.
settings.sidebarStyleDesc: Choose sidebar layout density and icon style. Applied live.
settings.sidebarWidthDesc: Drag to adjust sidebar width. Synced between settings and chat.
settings.sidepanelStyleDesc: Choose right panel layout and visual style. Applied live.
settings.sidepanelWidthDesc: Drag to adjust right panel width. Synced between settings and chat.
settings.timelineContentWidthDesc: Adjust max line width of messages and composer in the center area.
settings.pluginOwnDesc: theme-manager's own prefs, stored at ~/.pi-desktop/config/plugins-data/theme-manager/config.json (separate from desktop prefs).
settings.timelineThemeDesc: Independent theme for the center conversation area - only affects the center, not the sidebars/titlebar
settings.timelineThemeInheritDesc: Center follows the global theme without override
settings.fontSampleCode:
const sessions = await pi.sessions.list({ cwd });
for (const s of sessions) console.log(s.name);
settings.fontSampleText: The timeline renders message bubbles, tool calls and thinking blocks.
settings.previewAssistantAfter: provides mechanisms only — every feature is a plugin
